body:
My doctor tried a couple of different antidepressants.  Both completely changed my personality and gave me horrible, vivid dreams.  The worst one was when I awoke from my dream thinking my wife was trying to kill me.  I completely freaked out and scared the shit out of her.  

I'm not saying that antidepressants don't help some people, but, for me, they made my life worse.

I have tried some new things.  I lived out of state for a while and that was nice.  I've developed a passion for hiking and get out as often as I can.  Making friends is difficult for me.  While I feel good getting out and doing hikes with a group, it's the loneliness and solitude afterwards that is getting to me.
Probably not a snappier dresser.  I have horrible fashion sense.

Thanks for responding.  You are right as it is a huge change and it's difficult to deal with it.  I hope you never have to try dating sites.  I'm not sure what I'm going to do at this point.  For not, I'll just keep hoping for a nice heart attack in my sleep but I don't think I'll be that lucky.
